51047.t:
In the U.S. Senate race, Republican Bert Mizusawa carried Culpeper County by about 9 points over Democrat Mark Warner, 12,140 votes to 10,218. Trump had won the county by 25 points in 2024, so it moved 16 points toward the Democrats. That is slightly more than the typical Virginia county's shift of 15 points and close to Warner's statewide gain of 17. Counties of similar size and 2024 lean moved much the same way: Orange and King George each shifted 16 points, and Louisa 14.

Turnout was 22,411 votes, 78% of the 2024 total, so the count cannot tell voters who changed their minds from those who stayed home. Every one of Virginia's 133 counties moved left.
